title: Finite scheme Cech complexes as tail colimits
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,\pi)$ be a limiting cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves on $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with inverse-image transitions $\varphi_f$ satisfying the canonical identity and composition equations [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $G:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $\pi_i^{-1}F_i$, with arrows given by inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$. For any qcqs object $U$ in the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a finite type $K$, and a covering family $(f_k:V_k\to U)_{k\in K}$ with every $V_k$ qcqs, there exist $i_0\in I$, a diagram $A:I_{\ge i_0}\to\mathrm{CochainComplex}(\mathrm{Ab})$, etale objects $U_j,V_{j,k}$ over $D_j$, and covering arrows $f_{j,k}:V_{j,k}\to U_j$ for each $j\ge i_0$, isomorphisms $A_j\cong\check C^\bullet((f_{j,k}),F_j)$ [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex], and a colimit cocone $c_A$ on $A$ with $c_A.\mathrm{pt}\cong\check C^\bullet((f_k),L.\mathrm{pt})$. A cochain complex is a sequence of abelian groups with consecutive differential composites zero; the complexes here have degrees in the natural numbers. The tail has its induced order. No injectivity or positive cohomological vanishing is asserted.

theorem etale_limit_finite_cech_complex_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (U : c.pt.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left]
    (K : Type (u + 1)) [Finite K] (V : K → c.pt.Etale) (f : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U)
    (hV : ∀ k, CompactSpace (V k).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V k).left)
    (hf : Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology U) :
    ∃ (i₀ : I) (A : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j} ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℕ)
      (Uj : ∀ j : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}, (D.obj (op j.val)).Etale)
      (Vj : ∀ j : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}, K → (D.obj (op j.val)).Etale)
      (fj : ∀ (j : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}) (k : K), Vj j k ⟶ Uj j)
      (eA : ∀ j : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}, A.obj j ≅
        (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (fj j k))).obj
          ((Over.forget (Uj j)).op ⋙ (F j.val).obj))
      (cA : Cocone A)
      (eK : cA.pt ≅ (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (f k))).obj
        ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ L.pt.obj)),
      (∀ j : {j : I // i₀ ≤ j},
        Sieve.ofArrows (Vj j) (fj j) ∈ (D.obj (op j.val)).smallEtaleTopology (Uj j)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit cA)
